text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what should I do? Just thinking about 
it made me hungry~! All I can picture is 
food... I can't take it anymore!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, what have you been worrying 
about for a while now~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eep!? G-Grass-chan!? How long have you 
been standing there...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I've been here the whole time~ So, is 
there something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um... Grass-chan's birthday present... 
I was wondering what would be good."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My. Fufu, please don't worry about that~. 
Just the thought alone is more than 
enough♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, you always take such good care of 
me, so I really wanted to celebrate 
properly!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In that case, will you run with me? 
...Show me your full, serious speed, 
Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Can we do it after I eat!?
